purpose: Development rule defining how forge internals (SKILL, agents, scripts) may reach documents: only direct reference to built-in docs or query wrappers for project docs, and backend names confined to wrappers.
summary: Two allowed access routes: direct path reference to forge built-in docs, and query skills for project specs and rules
Route A scope: a skill may reference only its own docs directory; cross-skill docs references are forbidden
Docs shared by several skills must be promoted to plugin-shared docs
Rationale: built-in docs update with releases, while project docs change often so paths rot
Anti-patterns: querying built-in docs, referencing project docs from distributables, procedures written as docs, session_dir file handoff
Only wrapper skills and doc_backend scripts may reference the document search backend
Backend names, skill names, argument names and storage paths must not appear outside wrappers
Table of the single place per layer where a backend may be explained
External users read built-in docs via query-forge-rules, outside this principle
tasks: Writing or modifying forge SKILL.md files that read documents
Designing agents or scripts that need to access docs
Deciding how to reference built-in docs versus project specs and rules
Reviewing changes for cross-skill docs references
Writing documents that mention the document search backend
Moving shared docs into plugin-shared docs
